answer: The only reservation a State may make to the Council of Europe Framework Convention on Artificial Intelligence is provided for in Article 34, paragraph 1. It permits a State to declare, by written notification addressed to the Secretary General of the Council of Europe, that it avails itself of the reservation in Article 33, paragraph 1, which allows a federal State to reserve the right to assume obligations under the Convention consistent with its fundamental principles governing the relationship between its central government and constituent states or other similar territorial entities.
